title: Transfer Voucher
body:
This module adds an item: a teleportation ticket. 
Right-click the square to record its position; 
Press the left mouse button to cancel the record; 
Long press the Shift key and right-click for 3 seconds to teleport to the recorded location (across dimensions) and use up the teleportation voucher. 
By combining the teleportation token with the immortal totem, you can obtain the enhanced version of the teleportation token: The enhanced teleportation token will automatically trigger a return to the recorded location when the player dies (without having to hold it), will grant immunity to this death and provide some positive buffs. 
If there are multiple enhanced teleportation vouchers and they need to be used for the main hand and the secondary hand, if there are no handheld teleportation vouchers, then the vouchers in the earliest position will be consumed first.

本模组添加了一个物品：传送券。

右键方块记录位置；

Shift左键取消记录；

长按Shift右键 3 秒传送到记录的位置（可跨维度）并消耗传送券。

将传送券与不死图腾合成可获得强化版传送券：强化版传送券在玩家死亡时（无需手持）会自动触发回到记录位置，免疫此次死亡并获得一些正面 Buff。

如果有多个强化传送券优先使用主手和副手的，如无手持传送券就优先消耗最靠前格子里的券。
